INTRODUCTION

THE BOOK OF FLUTTERING BUTTERFLY WINGS

Muon Kiep Nhan Sinh Volume 1 by author Nguyen Phong, published at the height of the pandemic, truly created a rare publishing phenomenon in Vietnam. The book awakened dormant human intuitions, changed perspectives on life, and awakened consciousness in a world increasingly unstable and full of upheaval. Beyond publishing over 200,000 copies in 6 months, not counting Ebook and Audio Book distributions via Voiz-FM, First News received thousands of messages and emails of gratitude to author Nguyen Phong. This demonstrates the book's spreading power creating a phenomenon in Vietnam's 2020 reading culture.

The origin of Muon Kiep Nhan Sinh was a late-night phone call from Vietnam to the US in late 2016. Sensing the world surrounded by oppression, injustice, and evil unfolding daily, I proposed to author Nguyen Phong to write a book about Karma to warn and awaken humanity (the work Journey to the East which he adapted nearly fifty years ago had changed the consciousness of many generations of Vietnamese and was beloved until now).

At that time, author Nguyen Phong told me about the strange, special karmic past-life story of Thomas - a successful businessman in New York and also his close friend whom he had met at Taiwan University in 2008. After that late-night phone call, he quietly flew to New York to meet Thomas and proposed writing those unusual stories into a book.

And unexpectedly - Thomas agreed.

tieu_de: Part One - Departure: A World No Longer the Same
noi_dung:
Part one

DEPARTURE: A WORLD NO LONGER

LIKE BEFORE

I called Thomas many times but no one answered. This is something that rarely happens, because even when he's busy, Thomas will call me back right away. I emailed and texted via apps but got no response, no sign of having seen the message. This made me feel worried and insecure, not understanding what happened to my friend.

One late evening, it was almost midnight, I was suddenly startled by the phone ringing while I was writing the manuscript for the next book. Usually, it's rare for anyone to call me this late at night. I held the phone, on the other end of the line was Thomas:

- I'm very sorry, I haven't used the phone these days for some reason.

In recent days, you must have witnessed unexpected changes spreading. However, not only New York, or America, but almost the whole world is going through unprecedented crises. I also recently experienced strange disturbances and shifts in consciousness. A premonition told me that what Mr. Kris worriedly warned about was happening. I have not been able to contact Mr. Kris. Therefore, I really want to talk to you. I have many friends but not everyone I can share these things with. The upheaval will be much more widespread and complex than that, but it is only the beginning of a new era full of challenges and can change the world. I believe that things are going to happen globally that will be worse and will not be like the forecasts that people are reading in the news. Most people still don't fully understand the true and profound origin of what's going on...

I suddenly felt restless so I interrupted Thomas:

- I've also been following the situation going on. So what are your personal feelings?

- Do you remember the last time we met in Colorado, I shared with you Mr. Kris's prediction about important things that will happen in this world? It has been coming very quickly! Perhaps it is time for humanity to face the consequences of what it has done. Some large countries have entered the "destructive" cycle of the universe.

Even in the advanced United States with more than three hundred million people and the wider world of more than seven billion people, how many people clearly understand the law of cause and effect of the universe?

- I still remember those profound predictions of Mr. Kris.

I replied while recalling what Thomas said in the last meeting before parting.

Thomas' voice suddenly became distant:

- However, people in this world are still very subjective. They are living and following inertia rather than awakening. It's not that they don't have time, it's that they don't have the opportunity to wake up. Perhaps people need to learn their lesson! There is no other way. He also knows that awakening a bankrupt, unemployed or destitute person is easier than awakening those who are arrogant with many thick outer shells - such as wealth, fame, position, title, degrees... but their inner values ​​such as compassion, love and spiritual understanding are almost empty or too poor.

Stop for a moment, Thomas lowered his voice:

- Don't waste any more time. Tomorrow, fly to New York to meet me.

We need to continue to exchange important unfinished stories. I have arranged everything so that you can write in peace and rest. Please book your flight as soon as possible. Remember to let me know your flight time, I will pick you up at the airport. See you tomorrow.

I put the phone down and was silent for a few minutes. Thomas's voice has never been so urgent.

Not long ago, before the phone rang, I picked up The New Yorker magazine with the historic cover photo of a man playing the violin alone on a high, deserted rooftop. I had just looked at that cover photo for a long time and had some bad premonitions when Thomas's strange call unexpectedly coincided perfectly with my insecure feelings at that time.

I booked a ticket for the earliest flight to New York, packed some necessary luggage, a tape recorder and essential items for a not-so-short trip.

I suddenly felt a strange calmness. In my life, there have been many urgent flights like this. I'm a scientist so everything needs to be planned in advance, but with Thomas and in this situation it's different. This was no ordinary business flight. I know that the meeting with Thomas tomorrow is important not only for me.

It seems that deep in my consciousness there is a stirring of a sacred mission that has just suddenly come. That mission is not only mine but all of us for the future of this world.

New York

THE START OF A NEW ERA

John F. Kennedy Airport that afternoon was unusually deserted, different from the usual crowded scene. My flight was also empty and when we landed, everyone hurriedly left the airport. Thomas was waiting for me at the gate. He warmly welcomed me home to put my luggage and have a prepared dinner in the garden of his house in Manhattan.

After completing the recording of past life stories in previous meetings between me and Thomas, I intended to go to New York to visit him to ask him to review and continue the unfinished stories.

Before I could make an appointment with Thomas, he proactively invited me to his house.

Thomas welcomed me warmly, as if he had been waiting for this meeting for a long time. During dinner in the quiet garden, Thomas asked me about my health and work and said he was also eagerly waiting for my manuscript. After that, he told me the strange things he had experienced in the past few days that he could not finish on the phone. I listened attentively to every word Thomas said, sometimes stopping to take notes. He analyzed the deep roots of the unprecedented upheavals taking place and affirmed:

- It's all just begun.

Thomas was silent for a moment then continued:

- This is coming faster than we think. This world will probably never return to the way it was before. The lungs of this planet are being destroyed, strange deadly diseases are spreading, climate change is becoming more and more severe and the risk of war is looming with years of hidden conflicts about to erupt... All of what we are witnessing are just the beginnings of real earthquakes.

Suddenly Thomas looked at me and asked:

- Do you know who triggered all of that?

I answer:

- Through history, we all know that political, economic, and cultural trends are cyclical. They will flourish, then be eliminated, destroyed and reborn... The transformation of the world or human life as well as the endless cycles that in the previous discussion, we learned are called Cycles. We already know about d ong l ù c and ph an l ù c, what this planet is going through is a phase of jet influence. As for motivation, it is human actions. We seem to be entering a special period for the planet and may witness the beginning of a new era.

Thomas nodded:

- That's right, all human behavior is the source that triggers these phenomena. Just as he said, a new era is about to begin but before it gets there, the world will go through many crises, transitions and even destruction. We are entering a period of instability and rough seas, and right now it is difficult for anyone to accurately state the details of the world's future prospects. Humanity's seemingly outstanding science can only follow new events that continuously occur. But the future doesn't have to turn out in a bad way, because we can still influence to make the future better.

I agree with Thomas:

- I know there is nothing absolutely right and nothing that cannot be changed. The most obvious is that scientific concepts are different in each period. In some ways, I still believe that each person can still change their destiny.

Thomas listened and nodded:

- What you say is true for each individual and can also be applied to the whole.

We are witnessing an extraordinary time in the world, when the laws of the universe and nature are rotating on a large scale, encompassing everything in the circle of cause and effect. If we do not know the source of the woes the world is facing, there is nothing we can do to change it. There is an old proverb: "Ta t c a tai h ọ a d au b a t stupid oh n t yes it is our own thoughts and actions" . The cause that has been sown will bear fruit sooner or later. No matter how fast we run towards the future, ignoring past mistakes, using one thing to cover up another, sooner or later we will have to face the consequences of our past actions. Humans have destroyed this green planet at an unprecedented speed. In just a few short decades, the earth has begun to enter the sixth wave of extinction.

Natural disasters and epidemics will become increasingly terrible and occur more frequently, threatening human life. There will be unpredictable disasters in the future, sea levels will rise as the giant ice caps at the poles melt rapidly, possibly releasing many strange pathogens that have been buried for millions of years...

I pondered what Thomas said:

- Could it be that big countries can't join forces to find a solution? In your opinion, which solution is the most effective at this time?

Thomas smiled:

- You can clearly see that throughout history, major powers have never truly united and sat together to find a common direction. There are countries that are increasing their influence, ambition and intrigue, while other small countries are also struggling to take care of themselves.

As a scientist researching technology, he also knows that scientific and technological innovations always have two sides, good and bad, positive and negative. The development of engineering, technology and other commercial industries is always accompanied by the loss of natural resources. I have the opportunity to learn and see things more clearly after the profound things Mr. Kris shared. The fact that we met each other, exchanged experiences and favorite thoughts, leading to him writing them into a book, was not a coincidence, but also a special predestined relationship. The story I want to share with you next will be quite long, we can start developing this story from the perspective of science - in a world both visible and invisible. Many things that we do not know, cannot explain or cannot see does not mean they do not exist.

After we finished eating, it was already dark and starting to get cold. Every wind blows in from the sea. Thomas invited me into his office, carefully closing the door to avoid being disturbed. Thomas made a pot of hot tea for me. I noticed a beautiful painting of an ancient Greek scene on the main wall of the office, illuminated by a soft yellow light, next to the first telescope built by Chester Moore Hall in 1758 that is usually only seen in museums. On the large desk there is an open newspaper with an article related to the phenomenon of unidentified flying objects in UFO space.

Noticing my attention, Thomas pointed to the article and asked:

- What do you think about the UFO phenomenon?

Somewhat surprised that Thomas changed the subject, I replied:

- I don't often pay attention to things like this. Many people believe that there are space creatures visiting Earth. Others believe that it is just an exaggerated imagination influenced by science fiction novels.

Thomas smiled and said leisurely:

- Astronaut Edgar Mitchell, my close friend, you met him at Taipei University, you probably still remember, he told me a lot about the subject of UFOs.

Edgar believes UFOs are real but the US government has kept this a secret.

As a scientist at NASA's space research agency and one of six astronauts who set foot on the moon on Apollo 14, Edgar affirmed that there are many other planets in the universe, with creatures living on them. These creatures are probably not like humans, because the living conditions on other planets are different from Earth and some of them may have traveled through space to our planet.

I was surprised to hear him say that, so I asked again:

- Did Edgar confirm that? Did he share anything more with you?

Thomas answered:

- According to Edgar, this earth is not the only planet with life. Previously, although there were many reports and images of unidentified flying objects from many parts of the world, most were staged and fabricated. However, there are also some very reliable cases. For example, an alien flying saucer falling in Roswell, New Mexico in 1947 has clear images. Of course, the US government then placed a strict blockade on the entire area. All documents and images received are sealed as top secret so no one can check or verify. With his seniority working for the space research agency NASA, Edgar has seen documents that few people know about.

He said that a number of other scientists were also able to see it, but because they didn't want to get into trouble, no one wanted to say anything about it.

I found it very interesting, so I asked further:

- So what did Edgar tell you about what happened next?

Thomas slowly answered:

- The mention of the existence of alien creatures from a reputable person like astronaut Edgar Mitchell made NASA very awkward at that time. Afterwards, the agency's spokesman had to declare that NASA is a scientific research agency, not a place to monitor strange phenomena on this planet. They do not confirm or deny the existence of creatures on other planets, because this is not part of their research. NASA's main goal at that time was to send people to space.

Thomas thought for a moment, then continued:

- Edgar told me that he had mentioned details about the flying saucer crashing in Roswell with officials from the US Department of Defense. They told him that there were things that needed to be kept secret, because from that flying saucer, they had discovered many advanced, cutting-edge techniques, and could not let this secret slip into the hands of any other country. You know, at that time the cold war between the United States and the Soviet Union was in its most tense phase. The Ministry of National Defense has officially requested Edgar not to say anything more about the subject of unidentified flying objects.

At this point, I was really interested in the topic, so I continued asking:

- But has Edgar ever really seen a UFO?

Thomas shook his head:

- Even though he was an astronaut and had flown many times in space, and had also set foot on the moon, Edgar had never seen a strange flying object with his own eyes. However, he believes that the flying saucer that crashed in Roswell actually belonged to an extraterrestrial civilization that was secretly monitoring the development of our planet. The area where the flying saucer crashed in Roswell is a small village located near the White Sand, currently still a top-secret military blockade area of the United States, called Prohibited Area 51 (Prohibited Area 51).

Thomas thought silently for a while and then said:

- Edgar Mitchell is a very intelligent but straightforward person, he has a progressive mindset, wants to share knowledge with everyone, wants to expand scientific research Learn new horizons, discover new things that humans have never known. However, he also made many famous scientists at that time unhappy with his statements, and he also suffered a lot of public criticism, being accused of being "anti-science". Actually, few people in this world can understand the minds of geniuses, because their thinking is much beyond ours.

I was silent for a moment and then suddenly remembered what happened before:

- During a talk in Taipei with professor Raymond Yeh, astronaut Mitchell mentioned that the scientific revolution can overthrow old concepts that have existed up to now. At that time, Professor Yeh and I didn't think that could happen soon. Did Edgar say anything more about this?

Thomas nodded in confirmation:

- I remember at that time astronaut Edgar didn't say anything more, after that we didn't have a chance to go deeper into this issue. However, he still believes that it is time for us to seriously consider the unintended consequences that science and technology have created. He believed that with new scientific discoveries and data, one could change the foundations of experimental science that had been established for hundreds of years. Up to now, we have implicitly accepted some scientific knowledge and applications without questioning their true value and unwanted effects. Maybe this scientific knowledge was really useful at the time it was discovered, but now the world has gradually changed, we need new knowledge, more appropriate to today's actual situation. It's time to ask whether we can absolutely trust what we have accepted before? Of course, some people still believe in this knowledge, because the scientific foundation as well as economic, social, and humanistic theories are all built on it. But Edgar believes that in the future there will be new research and data discovered, proving that the values ​​we still believe in are no longer relevant and a new era will begin.

I continued asking:

- But does Edgar believe that today's scientific knowledge can collapse?

Thomas replied:

- Edgar said he thinks people tend to care about things that happen in the future and rarely go back to verify old beliefs. There are so many things that were considered "True" in the 19th century that have now been proven to be completely "Wrong". Today, looking back at a book of scientific theories of the 20th century, we see that there are fundamental flaws. Maybe these theories are not completely wrong, but they are not complete, have shortcomings, and need to be supplemented. We live on earth so our vision is often limited to one place, one city or one country, but when we step out into space, everything changes. When floating in that vast, endless space, we see that the entire earth is truly our beloved homeland. Since then, all discriminatory concepts about nation, race, politics, religion, culture, and society have changed. No one witnesses the greatness of the universe and the smallness of the earth without being startled by what we have done to our beloved earth. Edgar said it very clearly: "There is noanyone who wants to go out into space without changing their drive. There is noperson who has ever been in a place where m is in, i I'm hiding in l, i'm in the v in that c has imprisoned me for for so many years" . The conversation with Venerable Thanh Nghiem made Edgar think a lot about the relationship between humans and the universe. That gave him the motivation to boldly follow the path he proposed, that there would be a scientific revolution and change happening in the near future. Do you know why Edgar thinks like that?

I shook my head, Thomas continued:

- Because all the foundations of experimental science are based on human senses. They must see, hear, touch and use scientific instruments and machines to measure and verify. The more advanced the machinery and the more accurate the data, the more the theories are recognized. However, our senses are limited, so all our concepts, all theories, all our thoughts are imperfect. Through the experience of feeling one with all things, Edgar is clearly aware of the relationship between humans and the universe. When he returned, he asked questions and was surprised at the limitations of the experimental science he had pursued for so long. After a talk with Venerable Thanh Nghiem about the Avatamsaka Sutra, about the correlation and interconnection of all things in the world, Edgar told me that he had opened his eyes to new horizons that few scientists pay attention to. He did not expect that the Eastern sages had long known how to develop superior senses to break the limits that current science could not overcome. These are inner senses that, once discovered, can overthrow many flawed or erroneous concepts that we currently believe. That is why he is determined to promote research into the connection between science and inner experience. Currently, these studies are still continuing at the Vi Institute of Noetic Sciences that Edgar founded in California.

I asked further:

- How is this research progressing?

Thomas smiled:

- In the beginning, I often visited Edgar Mitchell and followed these studies. Nowadays, I don't pay much attention to this anymore. I want to spend more time on things I care about.

I was surprised:

- But weren't you one of the people who supported the establishment of the research institute as well as funded these studies?

Thomas was silent for a moment and then said:

- That's right, but these studies will hardly have results when people still seek solutions through outside scientific experiments instead of going into the field. internal root cause. This is similar to when we have a disease, we only take medicine to relieve pain and treat the symptoms, but do not find the cause that caused the disease and treat it completely.

I ask again:

- Why do you think like that?

Thomas looked at me attentively and answered:

- During a conversation with Mr. Kris, I accidentally asked about the existence of creatures from other planets. Mr. Kris believes that we should not worry too much about that. Currently, right now on this earth there are so many creatures that people do not know about, so many tragic fates that no one cares about or protects, so why should we care about creatures from distant planets? At that time, my pride arose, so I argued, what else is there on earth that people don't know? For many centuries now, humans have discovered everything that can be discovered, have thoroughly researched every living thing, every living condition, there is nothing left to learn more. This is the time to go into space to do research. At that time, Mr. Kris burst out laughing. He said: “Thousands of years ago, the sage Socrates taught his students: “Whatever you look for far away, let let hi let know yourself, because t let hi let yourself be hi to know to t be the universe to ” . A wise piece of advice that we can still apply today.

As you know, the universe is vast and vast, there are millions of planets, millions of solar systems, millions of (Nebula) Nebulae, all constantly rotating, constantly changing, some are born, some are lost, birth and death, never ending. However, if you turn inside and practice within, you will also see that there are millions of thoughts arising in your mind, all constantly spinning and changing, sometimes born, sometimes lost, born, destroyed, never ending. In short, is our mind any different from the universe? Therefore, if you know yourself, know the changes in your mind, you can also know the colorful events outside the universe."

After going through strange experiences and my own journey of awakening, I have become more and more fond of the saying I heard many years ago: "Please yes ng ng to m the stars when I meet t e there's still a lot left to do go about a hi to u h et".

At the beginning of this afternoon's conversation, I shared with you the unprecedented crises and upheavals of the world that are taking place. And to fully understand the roots and causes, we cannot go to the moon, Mars or Venus can find solutions for humans living on this earth. The solutions must come from within us.

Many intangible things that we do not fully understand are extremely important. It is karma that is impacting and greatly influencing our lives and the great events taking place out there will not stop.

Now I will tell you the stories Mr. Kris shared recently that I think are important. These stories are quite long and continuous so I have to meet him in person and cannot talk by phone or email. That's why I wanted to invite you to come with me for a few days. And I will not simply tell you, but from there we will find solutions to current and future problems. You and I will embark on a journey, a mission to contribute to sharing and spreading useful values ​​to everyone - as quickly as possible. We don't have much time left!

Even though the flight made me quite tired, I still want to start the story and take notes right away.

The following are interesting, wise conversations between Mr. Kris and Thomas, along with Thomas's journey of spiritual awakening.

THE MYSTERY OF OTHER WORLDS: THE JOURNEY

OF SOULS

Once when I met Mr. Kris, I humorously asked Kris, if we go inside, what will people discover? Can we answer the question of where humans come from or where they go when they die? Will we get a raise in salary after looking inward? Can business get better? Can we find solutions to life's problems that are too complicated and messy?

Mr. Kris did not pay attention to my teasing, he looked straight at me, seriously replied:

- Your question is a very serious and interesting issue, and is also a question of many people. People are always curious, they want to know and understand everything. But knowing what to do? No matter what I say, I can't satisfy everyone. If I say that humans came here from some planet, scientists will demand proof. If I say that humans evolved from low-level matter into creatures and then into humans, religions will not accept it. If I say that humans are born from a certain being, some people will question who gave birth to that being. If I affirm that there is a world of ghosts after people die, and that there is a world of ghosts that exists alongside us, people will force me to take photos of ghosts or bring a ghost for journalists to take photos and interview to believe it.

In short, all the answers do not satisfy everyone. If you want to understand, the only way is to turn inside, self-discover, search for answers through practice, contemplation, to understand the operation of the mind and the world, but that is the answer that only those who have truly experienced understanding, “nh u ng ui u ong n uc t bi is not hot, nh" , just talking about it is of no use. Nowadays, most people only know how to look outward, chasing frivolous things and not understanding the inner dynamics that govern their lives. Most people just run after distant illusions, going further and further, more lost, more disoriented, unable to return to their inner home. Everything that is directed outward will not bring lasting results - because true understanding must come from within. When the outside world changes so much that there is no longer any support, it is time for us to turn inside.

I listened attentively, found what he said very interesting but still could not hide my skepticism. Because until then, I was still a person of scientific thinking, although I had begun to have certain intuitions about the spiritual world. As if reading my thoughts, Mr. Kris slowly continued:

- What I say above is based on my experiences and understanding. Of course, my experience cannot be yours, nor can my understanding be yours, so it is natural for you to have doubts. You don't have to believe what I say, but you should experience and reflect for yourself to find your own answer. Mr. Kris laughed and replied:

- The universe is vast and vast with millions of planets, I cannot know what life is like in those places. However, according to my research, everything and everything in this universe is governed by the laws of Reincarnation and Cause and Effect. Right on this earth, in addition to the world of humans and animals, there are realms of other creatures that most people don't know about, so why bother looking so far?

I was very surprised and immediately responded:

- Did you just say there are other realms?

Mr. Kris nodded and confirmed:

- The (Realm) realms are regions made up of atoms with special vibrations compatible with the creatures living in that space. Depending on the structure and vibration of atoms, the form and constitution of living beings also change according to the circumstances of that realm. Our current world is made up of atoms with slow and rough vibrations, so it is suitable for the physical body, the world we see every day. In other realms, atoms vibrate so softly that our physical senses cannot perceive, hear or see them. These realms all have creatures living there, we just can't see them, but not seeing them doesn't mean they don't exist.

I thought more, then asked:

- So how do those realms relate to and affect our realm? Before now, I have never been aware of the existence of any other realm.

Mr. Kris looked at me, interested in the question, then calmly explained:

- The human world is limited by physical elements, while the world of other entities such as demons, angels, or saints is larger, covering the human world. There are also other, larger realms, spanning planets, solar systems, galaxies, beyond my understanding. As you know, slow and rough vibrations produce material elements, with fine and light vibrations, matter turns into energy. In the realms with light, sound vibrations of atoms, there are no physical elements, everything is just energy or thought. Because it is a realm of thought, entities in these realms can know human thoughts, while people in the physical realm cannot know other realms and thoughts in that realm.

I was startled and immediately asked again:

- You say that demons and gods can understand what we are thinking? Why?

Mr. Kris laughed:

- Of course it's possible. Not only demons, but also entities from other realms can easily know people's thoughts, thoughts, intentions, and actions. Let me give you an example to make it easier for you to understand. We are bigger than insects so we have a broader vision than them. If we observe an ant looking for prey on the ground and we see that not far away there is a grain of rice, but if the ant continues to walk it will find that grain of rice. Because the ant cannot see far, until it gets there, it doesn't know anything about that grain of rice. As for us, because we have a broader vision, we can foresee this and know the ant will find the grain of rice. Similarly, the higher realm has a greater vision, so entities in that realm can perceive or foresee some events that have not yet happened in this world.

Mr. Kris paused to let me reflect on what he had just said, then continued:

- Some people, through diligent cultivation, or have some special ability, have expanded their vision, and can predict some events that will happen for several decades or even centuries. then. They are often called prophets.

However, it should be added that these predictions are not always accurate. Because the future is never fixed but always changes depending on the changes in humanity's consciousness.

I ask further:

- So how can prophecies come true or not?

Mr. Kris slowly replied:

- No one can guarantee that everything will happen absolutely exactly according to a certain scenario. True prophets never speak directly but often only use metaphors, or figurative verses and implied words to warn humanity. Part Four

KARMA TRANSFORMATION: THE PATH

AWAKENING

Every year at Christmas, I often organize the company's key associates to go on vacation together to relax after a year of hard work. In addition, it was also an opportunity for us to meet and discuss work together for the coming year.

Two years ago, I invited everyone to my newly purchased vacation home in Colorado to rest and have the opportunity to climb and ski at Vail Mountain.

That afternoon, after returning from skiing, we sat down to eat together. Angie has prepared a sumptuous feast in advance. Everyone was having a meal when Connie turned to me and happily started a conversation:

- I heard Angie say that he was practicing meditation right now, which is a bit strange, because up until now, when Angie and I practice Yoga, he still laughs at us. What was the reason that made him change his attitude like that?

Angie laughed and added:

- Not only does he practice meditation, but he can also sit longer than me. When practicing Yoga, I only meditate for about ten minutes, because I easily fall asleep, but he can sit for more than half an hour and still stay awake.

The whole dining table was bustling because everyone was teasing me. Brian smiled and said:

- It seems like sometimes you meditate right in your office, right? The secretary said that sometimes he closed the door and did not receive visitors.

I answered gently:

- Sometimes I need to rest to relax my mind. Sometimes thinking too much causes stress, so we need to sit quietly for a bit.

Connie smiled thoughtfully:

- Sitting still to rest and meditating are different. I heard Angie say that he studied meditation with a neighbor recently. Angie said he was extremely knowledgeable and knowledgeable about Karma Yoga. I'm also wanting to learn more about Karma Yoga. Can I meet him?

The conversation at the dinner table turned to the topic of Yoga. Some people say it's just an Indian fitness method being exploited in gyms.

Others say it's a religion. Angie excitedly spoke up:

- According to Mr. Kris, the history of Yoga spans thousands of years but the essence has been lost, only the practice method remains. Mr. Kris is a person who knows very well about Yoga, I have never met anyone who can explain Yoga so clearly. Furthermore, he is truly a person with rare knowledge. If you want, we can invite Mr. Kris here so he can talk about Yoga.

I don't want to bother my friends, but everyone is curious to get to know this neighbor of mine who has knowledge about Yoga. Because Angie told me those details, Connie was very excited and insisted on meeting Mr. Kris to learn about Yoga.

The next day, Angie and Connie came to invite Mr. Kris to my house for dinner. As soon as he met me, Mr. Kris smiled and said:

- I don't often leave home but I can't refuse your sincere invitation. I heard that this lady will show off her cooking skills today?

Angie happily:

- I like cooking and don't mind showing off my talent to people who know how to enjoy it. Because I know he only eats fruit, I prepared some fruit dishes just for him.

We invited Mr. Kris into the house and introduced him to everyone. At the same time, everyone introduced themselves to him. After saying hello, we sat at the table, eating and chatting. While everyone happily enjoyed the new dish prepared by Angie, Connie turned to Mr. Kris with an excited voice:

- Angie said that Mr. Kris is a wise man, very knowledgeable and also knows a lot about Yoga. We are pleased to speak with you. As someone who practices Yoga, I want to learn more about the traditions of this subject. I heard that you previously gave a talk about Karma Yoga here, unfortunately I was not present. If possible, please tell me more about this subject.

Mr. Kris smiled and happily explained:

- Karma is Sanskrit meaning action ( Action). An action that occurs can both come from a cause in the past and be the cause for things to come in the future. Therefore, cause ( Cause) and effect ( Effect) are closely related in the Karma Yoga tradition. In other words, Karma refers to the connection between cause and effect in all human actions.

Connie was surprised:

- I practiced Yoga with Indian masters but no one said anything about cause and effect.

They only say Yoga is a method to make the body healthy and prevent diseases.

Mr. Kris explained:

- That's right, they only teach methods, not the essence, because they only focus on making money. People often want to be healthy for enjoyment, so they only focus on exercise methods to get better, few people know how to find out the real cause of illness. Why do healthy athletes still suffer from all kinds of diseases? Why has science progressed so far but incurable diseases are still on the rise? If you only look at Yoga as an exercise method, it is a huge omission.

Brian spoke up:

- Is Karma a Hindu concept?

Kris shook his head:

- No way. Although the word Karma is used a lot in Hindu and Buddhist books, Karma is the law of the universe (Universal Law). The Bible also talks about this issue, when Saint Paul told the Galates: "Do not be deceived; God is not mocked; for whatever one sows, that will he also reap (*).

(*) Galatians VI:7: Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap.

Brian asked:

- So the law of the universe is different What about social laws?

Kris looked at Brian, smiling:

- You are a lawyer, right? So you also know that social laws are set by people, forcing people to do or avoid doing something. This law changes depending on social circumstances, culture and time It may be reasonable at this time but will no longer be applicable at another time. Because social law is created by humans, it can change. On the contrary, cosmic law never changes, it is immutable and immutable in all space or time

Brian asked further:

As soon as I saw her, I felt like I had seen this person before somewhere. Mrs. Ginger happily invited us into the luxurious living room, which was decorated with many photos of famous movie actors of the past. - Who do you live here with?

- I live alone. During the day, a maid comes to help me, but at night I am alone. I'm still healthy and don't need an assistant to stay with me overnight.

The next day, I visited Mr. Kris to ask him a few questions when applying the meditation practice method he instructed. During the conversation, I accidentally told about the meeting with Mrs. Ginger.

Mr. Kris smiled:

- I know Mrs. Ginger, she lives nearby. And you, how did you feel when you met her?

- Maybe he hasn't met Mrs. Ginger in this life, but did in a previous life?

I laughed and replied:

- Let alone people, even objects are the same. There are things I like as soon as I see them, and there are things I never pay attention to.

Mr. Kris smiled and pointed to the ancient painting on the wall:

- Were you attracted to that painting when you first came here? What about the jade stick? That's because they remind him of a connection from ancient times.

I nodded:

- Inanimate objects can really be related to humans, how wonderful it is.

Mr. Kris nodded and added:

- Some objects containing electrical energy (Magnetic Energy) can remind of ancient connections. For example, the jade stick has been associated with him for many centuries. - When a person with a relationship from a past life appears in our lives, it is often a sign that some debt in the cycle of cause and effect is time to be resolved. Of course, not many people realize when this happens.

Normally, when meeting someone who comes to repay a debt, everyone happily accepts it, thinking that they are lucky to meet a noble person to help. However, when meeting people who come to collect debt, almost everyone is dissatisfied, blames, blames this person or that person instead of accepting to learn that lesson.

I wonder:

- If so, what relationship do Mrs. Ginger and I have with each other?

Mr. Kris thought silently for a moment and then nodded:

- As I said, you should have personally explored your personal connections to understand the law of Karma and Reincarnation. But okay, let me help you one more time.

Just like last time, I sat still for a while until Mr. Kris whispered something in my ear in a strange language, making me fall asleep.

I had to constantly ask the slaves what this and that were, what they were used for, and caused a lot of jokes because of the image of my new bride being both stupid and homely. It was an unexpected and extremely bitter turning point for me. I sadly look back at my past life.

I know that my personality is much like that of men, but I am still a girl and like other girls, I grew up with a secret dream of an ideal lover for me. The secret glances of the young men in the tribe towards me every time I appeared also made me excited.

I don't like makeup or beauty treatments because I think chasing after external beauty will reduce my value. I often look at my sister with disdain when I see her shy, acting timid, meek, and shy in front of the boys in the tribe.

With other women in the tribe, watching them suffer during pregnancy and difficulties during childbirth, I often feel pity rather than sympathy. In my head, there are always calculating thoughts about profit and loss in revenue and expenditure, about controlling everything in the tribe. The insinuations, smiles, and affectionate gestures of the men in the tribe rarely bother me, because I always believe that I will meet an honorable man worthy of me. He must be a smart, healthy husband who knows how to take charge and take care of his family, and I will also take care of that person to have a warm and happy family life.

Actually, I never thought there would come a time when my life would fall into such a bitter and terrible marriage.

Azhida's family once had a mandarin in the court, but by this time he had declined and turned to trading in the market. However, they still cling to the golden past with the rituals of the old regime. During a meal, food must be served to the head of the family first, then to the others, in turn according to high and low status in the family. Finally, how much is left before it's the servant's turn? Nabu, the head of the family, has a stomachache and can't eat much, so he has to choose his food very carefully - what can be eaten and what must be avoided. The daughter-in-law in charge of cooking, which is me, will have to know how to choose dishes carefully, arrange them beautifully and bring the dishes to the table in order, which dish comes first, which dish comes last. After bringing out each dish and waiting until the whole family finished eating, it was my turn. There were times when everyone finished eating and there was nothing left, so I had to starve. However, being full or hungry doesn't bother me, but my mother-in-law's attitude is the problem.

Garu, my mother-in-law, treats me extremely harshly. From the first day she saw my confusion and clumsiness, she scolded me with the harshest words. At first, I was not used to it, but I immediately reacted, making Ba Bac angry, screaming and having an asthma attack, coughing dryly and having difficulty breathing.

Azhida ran to teach me a lesson about my duties as a bride with a fierce beating. I also fought back fiercely. This incident happened over and over again during the first months I returned to my husband's house. After being brutally beaten many times, sometimes with sticks, sometimes with whips, then locked in the kitchen and starved for many days, not to mention the monthly troubles that occur to a woman's body, gradually, my body began to become exhausted. However, with my stubborn nature, I still refused to give in. Much later, I got used to the beatings and torture so I no longer reacted. and I began to understand the pain and suffering of women oppressed by harsh laws and rules that had to be followed.

Garu liked to prove her authority to me by shouting and ordering me to do what she wanted. No matter what I do, in her eyes I am wrong, so I am always scolded by her. Garu has asthma. Every time he screams, he coughs and has difficulty breathing, and I get beaten again. After each time she criticized and scolded me, she would raise her voice and talk about her upper-class lineage, how the dishes had to be elaborately cooked, displayed on silver and gold plates, and then she would sarcastically mock the ignorance and homeliness of people living in the desert like me. She said:

- I don't understand why my son chose a barbarian like you as his wife? How could noble people like us intermarry with low-class, ignorant people in the desert like you?

At first I didn't know why Azhida chose me. Later I realized it was because of the gold and livestock my father had to spend as a dowry. That is a large fortune that can help Azhida's family live comfortably for quite a long time.

Azhida's family has three children, Azhida is the eldest son, Sheva and Sherim are two daughters a few years younger than me. Nabu, Azhida's father, was just a merchant in the market, not comparable to the richest Nacharuchem family of Ashur, with a large trading group traveling everywhere to buy and sell goods. When Nabu accompanied the Nacharuchem family to my family's oasis, he witnessed the dowry negotiations between the two families. Seeing that Nacharuchem enjoyed a large amount of gold and a lot of livestock, he became greedy. He discussed with his son, Azhida, marrying me so he could negotiate a dowry for his family, which was not rich at all. Therefore, my marriage is actually just a sale and barter, and I have to suffer just because I am a girl. Sometimes Neveni and Shamuram would stop by the house to invite Azhida and her sisters out, but Azhida never let me come along. What made me even sadder was that Shamuram didn't pay any attention to me. Although we don't get along and often argue, we are siblings after all. So I don't understand why since the day I ascended Ashur, Shamuram has not visited me or cared about my miserable condition. When she and her husband came to visit, I had to bring food to the guests and she looked at me indifferently like a stranger. Not a word of greeting, not a word of love. I don't understand, why can you be so insensitive? In her eyes, I was nothing more than a slave in the kitchen.

Shamuram is luckier than me, because Neveni's mother passed away many years ago, so from the position of daughter-in-law, she automatically became the powerful female head of the Nacharuchem family. Every time I see her dressed in beautiful, luxurious clothes, happily smiling next to her husband, I can't help but think of my unfortunate situation and wonder why I am so unlucky?

I continued to live in a cramped kitchen for a long time. During the day I had to cook and do hard work under the harsh control of my mother-in-law. At night, I had to endure Azhida's animalistic demands, especially when he came home drunk and began to become violent. The pride and tenacity of the desert girl in me had completely disappeared in the body of a woman who was abused day and night. More than ever, I am extremely miserable and dissatisfied with my position as a weak woman who can only grit my teeth and endure such humiliating behavior. I can only find solace by reminiscing about the days when I was free to live in the desert, with the vast golden sand sea reaching to the horizon.

One day, Nabu returned home with a serious expression. During the meal, he sat down to eat but his mind was still elsewhere so he did not finish the meal. Finally, he called his wife and son into a private room, apparently to discuss something important. A while later, Azhida came to see me, he softly said:

- My father borrowed a large amount of gold from Nacharuchem's family as capital for his recent trading business, but unfortunately he suffered a loss. Now we don't know how to compensate for this gold. Time is urgent, if we cannot pay, our family will definitely face difficulties. I want you to go home and ask your family for some gold to make up for it, then I will treat you accordingly.

In my surprise, before I could say anything, Garu walked out, she also lowered her voice:

- Seriram, after all, you are a member of this family, you can't let it become famous.

At that moment, the anger that had long been stored in my heart suddenly surfaced, causing me to blurt out:

- This family doesn't have any reputation that they're afraid of losing.

Azhida immediately turned around, he raised his hand to hit me but Garu stopped him. She whispered in Azhida's ear but I could still hear:

- Wait, this is the time to need it. His rich family can help us at this time.

I sneered:

- You guys have already taken a large amount of gold and a herd of cattle, now do you want to take more?

Azhida got angry and shouted:

- If you don't bring the gold back here, I will slit your face.

My stubborn and resilient nature has returned, I shouted back at him:

- If you're good, do it! But don't try to take anything more from my family.

As soon as I finished speaking, I immediately received a heavy slap in the face, followed by continuous punches and kicks.

I was locked in the room and starved for many days. My whole body was covered in wounds, in extreme pain, but my strong nature did not allow me to shed a single tear. I lay thinking about my unfortunate life and continued to ask resentful questions. Why can an irresponsible girl like Ms. Shamuram, who only cares about playing around all her life, only knows about clothes, makeup, and make-up, enjoy the good things, live a rich and happy life with such a good husband? While someone as knowledgeable and talented as me has to live in a bad family, with an abusive husband like Azhida? I was drowning in the resentment of these why questions, and for the first time I realized that my resourceful intelligence could not help me, much less give me answers.

Many days passed, I was still lying there thinking, suddenly the door to the room opened and my father walked in. Before I could stop being surprised, Nabu and Azhida also followed. Nabu explained:

- You see, your son miscalculated in business, causing us to lose a large amount of gold. What are you going to do now?

Before I could make any excuses, my father spoke up:

- If he did something wrong, I will make it up to you, you don't need to say much.

I sat up, despite the pain in my body, and was about to speak out to refute that unjust slander, but my father signaled me to stop:

- Lie still there, let me talk to Nabu.

My father and Nabu walked out, Azhida was still standing there, he looked at me and smiled faintly:

- If you don't want to go back and ask your father, let's call him.

I wanted to scream and curse him, but my sore throat could only mumble out a few whispered curses. Azhida laughed heartily:

- It's useless for you to be stubborn, your father has already brought the gold.

I was both angry and bitter for my sad fate, but my body was in too much pain, I couldn't say anything but could only glare at Azhida. He let out a mocking smile and left. The next day I was taken out. I saw my father standing there with a caravan of camels carrying a lot of luggage. My father said:

- Get on the camel, I'll take you there.

At that moment Nabu and Azhida walked out, their faces beaming. Azhida looked at me, arrogantly:

- I return you to your father, from now on don't come here again.

The group left Ashur a long way before I spoke up:

- Why do you have to suffer like that?

- You don't need to say anything. I know they're just trying to ask me for some more gold.

Up to now you have done everything accurately, I know it can't happen like they say. Therefore, I asked Nacharuchem's family carefully about this matter as well as the amount of gold they had borrowed, then I paid double to redeem you. However, now you can't go home, I'm so sorry...

I'm surprised:

- Why can't you go home? So where can I go?

My father sighed, then said:

- You are already a member of the Azhida family, you no longer belong to our family. This is a rule from ancient times. Therefore I cannot return to the tribe. I'm the chief, I can't create a precedent that could cause chaos later. Father has arranged for you to go to a far away place. This time, I will go to Persia to exchange goods and will send you there. You are young, you can rebuild your life. You can also learn the lessons you need to learn on this trip.

I looked at my father, my throat choked and I couldn't say anything more. I looked out at the vast desert in front of me and muttered:

- At least I am free.

Father looked at me with sympathetic eyes and gently said:

- I told you before that you must put away your pride, complacency, anger, and quarreling with others, but you didn't listen. Mom and I often argue because I don't obey her, but I forget she's the one who gave birth to me and takes care of everything in our house. I despise everyone because I think I'm smarter and more talented. I warned you because I knew those traits wouldn't bring anything good, but unfortunately you didn't understand. I'm sorry for what you went through at the Azhida family, but now everything is over, I hope you've learned your lesson and changed to rebuild your life.

I didn't answer my father, but in my heart I was completely dissatisfied. I'm not satisfied. I think all the events that happened in my life were due to ironic circumstances and that I was a victim of the tradition of favoring men over women, not my fault. Why doesn't my father comfort me but is also troubled by my personality? Why don't you think it was my family that pushed me into this tragic situation? I have done nothing wrong to deserve this sad fate...

My later life in Persia was just flickering, blurry images, without many clear lines. There, I lived a normal, uneventful life, but was also extremely depressed, because the damaged person inside me was no longer interested in life. I looked after the business and kept the books for a Persian merchant, a friend of my father. The work is so easy that it's boring. I also closed the door and did not want to meet anyone anymore, so I lived day by day with unanswered questions about the status of women. The painful experience in this life has made me extremely afraid of the fate of a woman with so much bitterness and pain. The time I spent being the wife of a ferocious maniac, enslaved under the oppression of my mother-in-law, constantly suffering scolding, beatings, and torture left me extremely haunted.

Now that I think back, I still see it as a horrifying nightmare and I wonder if it's something that many other women also have to go through. I also wonder when did the issue of favoring men over women arise? Why has it remained unchanged after so many ages? Why do people born as women have to endure such repression and oppression? All over the world, how many women are entangled in similar sufferings and cannot find a way out because of this narrow prejudice?

I am constantly tormented by injustices in society. Why is it that as sisters in the same family, fate arranges for one person to live a happy life while the other person suffers countless misfortunes? What is the reason why some people are loved and live in wealth and prosperity while others are treated cruelly and endure humiliation and extreme misery? Why do cruel, barbaric people who specialize in beating others like Azhida enjoy gold, silver, and wealth just by getting married? Why do bitter, cruel people who consider torturing others as fun like Garu live a comfortable and happy life? Where do the injustices in life come from?

These unanswered questions continued to torment me without a solution, until I passed away from a serious illness at the age of twenty-eight, ending an arduous life.

***

That day, after I regained consciousness, I couldn't help but be shocked. I sat silently for a long time

to calm down and regulate the intense emotions just experienced. When I calmed down, the questions that followed me until the last days of my life in my other life came back. I asked these questions to Mr. Kris, and he said:

- To answer these questions, he must ponder and explore the profound mechanisms of the law of Cause and Effect. People are born in different circumstances, different countries, with different male and female bodies, and all kinds of happy and miserable situations all have previous causes. As I said before, life is a school where people come to learn necessary lessons.

I ask again:

- So what lesson is it to learn to be a woman who suffers a lot of abuse and suffering, or those who are born into orphans and are oppressed and disadvantaged, those who are born into families with miserable circumstances? Why do they have to endure such oppression, injustice, and discrimination?

Mr. Kris was silent, thoughtful for a moment, then calmly replied:

- According to my understanding, there are many lessons that people need to learn in one lifetime. Some people who are insensitive and indifferent to the suffering of others often have to be born as women to learn the lesson of love and reduce selfishness. They become mothers to develop more love, because there is no mother who does not know how to love. Some people who have a hot temper and are easily angry over small things and then say rude and cruel words that hurt others are often born as orphans, lacking love, experiencing misery, being bullied, and scolded, just to reduce this habit of anger. They are put in situations of being bullied and beaten to understand the hurt of others and learn empathy, developing more love.

Some small-minded people in their previous lives are often born as people with difficult and tragic family circumstances, forced to experience a lot of bitterness and hardship to be able to shoulder and protect their loved ones. From there, they will develop more generosity and tolerance. Only when suffering will they find a way to escape suffering and develop a heart to spread love to others. Everything that happens has a reason and is also an opportunity to learn. Nothing happens by accident, everything is a lesson, because people need to learn to become more knowledgeable. Humanity is also gradually learning to understand better, as you can see, today, many women in Eastern or Western countries no longer have miserable conditions like before. Everything has changed a lot, and the lessons that follow each human condition have also changed. Anyway, everything that happens is the result of causes sown in the past. The present life is only a small part of the intricate and complex chain of cause and effect.

Seeing that I still looked thoughtful, Mr. Kris leisurely explained further:

- People who create karma must reap the consequences, that is a very natural thing.

That is logic, never fails and never changes. The purpose of the Law of Cause and Effect is to motivate people to learn and transform. As in his last life in Assyria, Nabu had a stomach ache and could not eat much, because in his previous life he was a glutton. He ate and drank excessively, wasting a lot of food, so that during his life in Assyria, he was born with a weak digestive system, forcing him to limit his eating. I don't know if Nabu knows how to ask why he has that disease. Smart people must know how to ask questions and not blame heaven and earth. This earth has enough food for everyone and every species of creature. The reason why some people lack food is because someone wastes food or greedily takes away other people's food. People need to eat to live, but if they eat too much or are too wasteful, they will have to suffer the consequences later. Likewise, Garu was born with asthma, often coughing and having difficulty breathing because in her previous life she was someone who often used power to oppress those under her authority. The problem is whether she knows how to question the reason why she was born with that disease. If she doesn't consider changing and still suffers from the same disability, continues to oppress and scold others, she will have to go through many lifetimes with more terrible illnesses, to learn the lesson she must learn.

Mr. Kris looked at me and said seriously:

- During his life in Assyria, he was a sharp and intelligent person, admired by everyone, but he was arrogant, liked to quarrel, always thought he was right and others were wrong, so he had to repay his karma right in that life with a miserable life, being tortured, beaten, despised, scolded, because of the "cause" of thinking he was more talented than others, valuing himself too highly, the "karma" came right through having to work as a slave. others, this fruit is for you to learn never to be arrogant and judge others no matter how wrong they are or how low their qualifications are. Because any thought or word creates a cause, and if there is a cause, it will certainly create an effect. In that life, he was stubborn, stubborn, and lacked respect for his mother as well as his siblings in the family. Even though his mother was the one who raised and educated him, he grew up arrogant, did not listen to her and often argued and quarreled with her. That was the reason why he fell into a life of being dependent on his husband's family, being controlled and dictated by his mother-in-law, no longer free and leisurely.

I sat still, thinking about who I was during my life in Assyria and felt somewhat ashamed of my arrogance and judgment at that time. I didn't think karma could come so quickly. As if reading my thoughts, Mr. Kris added:

- Karma can come at any time, sometimes it comes quickly, sometimes it comes slowly, sometimes it is hidden until the next life. Many people do not understand why things happen to them because they have forgotten the causes they sowed before. The cause we create will attract surrounding influences to create results. You reap what you sow.

Not wanting to continue thinking about the horrifying experience of life in Assyria, I switched to another topic:

- You said earlier that Mrs. Ginger and I were related to each other. What is that story?

Mr. Kris looked at me with interest, then laughed:

- You still don't realize it? Mrs. Ginger is Shamuram in the life you just remembered. This person used to be a saint in a very ancient life, had great merit and did many good deeds, helped many people, so in her later lives she was born with a beautiful appearance, that's why this person began to be infatuated with her beauty and then became arrogant, selfish and lost her way. Having gone through many lifetimes of floating, sometimes up, sometimes down, this person is still ignorant and has not learned anything. This person is always engrossed in chasing a flashy appearance, likes clothes, likes makeup, jewelry, likes to beautify herself, likes the praise and worship of others... In her current life, although she is beautiful and once famous, she never enjoys happiness and still lives alone. Actually, Mrs. Ginger's life is a tragedy that few people know. I also consider myself destined to know her quite well. When she first got married, her husband was an alcoholic, causing her to suffer very much until he passed away. After that, she remarried, but soon divorced because her husband was constantly sick and had an unpleasant personality, so the two were incompatible. She got married for the third time and this husband died early.

Even though she inherited a large fortune, in the end she still lived alone, with no children, no close friends, and was always lonely. On the outside, everyone thinks Ginger is happy, but few people know her suffering and desire for happiness. For many lives, she lived selfishly, thinking only of herself, only knowing how to groom her clothes and makeup, without paying attention to anyone else. She only loves herself and her beauty. Therefore, in this life she did not have family happiness, nor could she have children. When people only know themselves and do not know how to love or think about others, they will create the cause of loneliness. People like that, if they don't know how to ask themselves questions and contemplate to find the cause, even if they go through many lives, they still won't understand why they are so unhappy. They don't do anything bad or harm anyone, but at the same time they don't know how to open their hearts to others. They only think about their beauty, fame, and wealth. If they don't know how to look inside and consider the cause and only blame their unfortunate fate, they won't learn the lesson they need.

Mr. Kris paused as if to let me ponder what he had just said, then he continued:

- Because Mr. and Mrs. Ginger had a connection from the Assyrian life, in this life, as soon as they met, he felt a sense of belonging. But not everyone is that sensitive. In most cases, even if people have been related for many past lives, it is still difficult to recognize each other, and if they have a feeling, they cannot guess the meaning of the relationship. Life has many complex cause and effect relationships that only people with enough understanding can recognize. Why do some people who love each other have to be apart? Why do people who don't like each other have to keep seeing each other? Almost everyone in this situation only knows how to blame and complain, but few people know to see it as the consequence of karma that has been caused before.

Suddenly, there was a strange force urging me to speak up:

- So believe me, is there anything I can do to help Mrs. Ginger?

Mr. Kris nodded:

- You can help Mrs. Ginger open her heart to those who are unfortunate.

Because this person needs to learn about giving love instead of only thinking about themselves.

I thought about Ginger's unhappy marriage and blurted out:

- Is it because she doesn't know how to love that Mrs. Ginger's marriage is not happy?

Mr. Kris smiled and answered:

- All people who come together as husband and wife have previous relationships with each other. Marriage is both a fate and a debt. Nothing happens by accident. In the intricate chain of cause and effect, people also have complex relationships with each other, so marriage can be debt repayment, debt collection, or sometimes both. Everything that happens is the result of causes sown in the past.

When two people meet and love each other, they certainly have known each other from previous lives. In this life, they get married because there are many causes between the two of them, both good and bad, that are starting to bear fruit and need to be resolved. Just by observing, we will see that anyone has the opportunity to meet people with whom they can get married, because everyone has connections from previous lives. However, they will choose an emotional bond with someone to gradually resolve their karma. Therefore, marriage is partly cause and effect, partly due to human will. This can be compared to a person standing at a crossroads and having four paths to choose from. They can choose any path and depending on the path they choose, they will be comfortable and peaceful or will encounter difficulties and obstacles. Marriage is the same, people choose their wives and husbands due to the binding karma from many lifetimes and depending on their decision to choose their spouse, their married life will be happy or miserable.

I wonder:

- What about those who have difficult relationships or are widowed when they are young but cannot rebuild their lives?

Mr. Kris looked at me and leisurely answered:

- Surely you still wonder about Seriram's case when he left Assyria to Persia, right? Persian society at that time was not much different from Assyria, women also suffered many disadvantages, so after that Seriram did not want to get married anymore because he was too afraid of marriage. In another case, there are people who want to get married but their relationship is always difficult, they love but are not reciprocated, that is also due to causes created in a previous life, maybe in a certain life they abandoned and betrayed their true love, causing others to suffer. Maybe they did not fulfill their responsibilities as a husband or wife, causing harm to their partner.

Therefore, in this life they must receive retribution to learn the lesson about the value of love. People who are used to living selfishly, only thinking about themselves, not knowing how to love, not knowing how to give love, often have to go through lonely lives, sometimes having to live alone in desolate lands to learn lessons about the value of love and relationships. Because, only when we see the loss or lack of something, do people clearly see its value and necessity.

***

When I returned home, I saw a strange car parked in front of the house. Entering the house,

I was surprised to see Mrs. Ginger sitting and chatting with Angie. This time when I met Mrs. Ginger again, I didn't look at her as a stranger anymore, but rather as a bit dear and felt more or less sorry. Angie saw me and happily said:

- I'm home. Today I cooked a special dish so I invited Mrs. Ginger to have dinner with my husband and me. You were away all day so I didn't have time to tell you.

I happily sat down next to Mrs. Ginger:

- I was very happy to see her again and honored that she accepted my invitation to have dinner with us and my husband.

The meal took place in an intimate, cozy atmosphere. Angie is not only a good cook but also knows how to make Mrs. Ginger tell stories about Persian movies starring famous actors in Hollywood. Normally I don't care much about this topic, but during the meal that day I also contributed to the conversation and treated Mrs. Ginger thoughtfully. When leaving, she held Angie's hand, her voice emotional:

- I'm so glad to know you and your grandparents. It's been more than sixteen years since I've had a cozy, intimate dinner like this. Usually I just eat alone at home. Very sad!

Angie squeezed her hand and said enthusiastically:

- We are still here until the end of this week. Please come and have dinner with us every evening for fun. I really like cooking and know many special dishes.

In addition, I don't know anyone here so I need friends. Getting to know a famous person like her is a great honor for my husband and I.

Since then. Ginger and Angie become close friends. Ginger often comes to visit and have dinner every time we come here to rest and we often visit her. One time, when we visited her and saw Angie dressed simply and without style, Mrs. Ginger pointed to her wardrobe and said:

- Even though we haven't known each other for long, we are as close as sisters. I have a lot of luxury clothes designed by famous fashion houses, but have never worn them. I want to give you some if you don't mind.

Angie smiled and gently refused:

- Thank you, but I'm used to dressing simply like this, fashionable clothes don't suit me.

Ginger smacked her mouth and sighed:

- Actually, I don't know what to do with these clothes. This year I'm ninety years old, I don't know how much longer I can live...

As if compelled by something, I spoke up:

- So what are you going to do with these things?

Mrs. Ginger shook her head and sighed:

- I have no relatives or children. Honestly, I don't know what to do with these things anymore?

Angie wondered:

- Why don't you give these things away? What do you keep when you don't use it anymore?

Mrs. Ginger smiled sadly:

- For whom now? I don't know anyone else. For many years I have lived alone.

Currently, my grandparents are my only friends.

Angie was surprised:

- I thought she had many more friends? As a famous movie actress like you, you must know many people in Hollywood?

Ginger shook her head, her voice sad:

- Where are they all dead? I am one of the last of the generation of movie actors in the 50s. The directors, actors and people who worked with me in the past have all passed away long ago. There's no one else...

The atmosphere in the room suddenly slackened. We looked at the room with luxurious glass cabinets full of expensive fashion clothes, hundreds of pairs of shoes of all styles and colors, arranged neatly and carefully. Suddenly, I had an idea:

- Why don't you auction these things and use the money for charity? I'm sure many people will want to buy it as a souvenir, especially the fans who still love her through the movies Ba Tuong starred in.

Mrs. Ginger was startled, she was stunned for a moment then seemed to wake up, she opened a bright smile:

- That's right, you said it very well. But I didn't think of it. I should do so, because now I don't need these things or money for anything. That's right, I'm willing to give everything to charity, can you help me?

***

In a later conversation with Thomas, he said that he and his wife were married

organized a birthday party for Mrs. Ginger in New York to auction off this artist's memorabilia. The proceeds from the auction were used to establish a charity fund in her name. This fund will sponsor actors who play supporting roles and staff working on film sets with limited finances.

The evening party was attended by a large number of movie actors and famous Hollywood figures who came to congratulate Ms. Ginger's career. Many Wall Street businessmen also contributed to this fundraising event.

MARRIED MUSIC: COSMIC SOUL

I was working in the office when I received news that Wilson G. - one of our investors from the early days of the company - was dying in a hospital bed. We quickly boarded a plane to Arizona, hoping to have the chance to see him one last time. In a busy life, only the last moments of life are when people have the opportunity to live most sincerely and honestly with each other.

Wilson comes from a family with a tradition of cattle farming in Texas, a profession associated with the romantic cowboy style, a familiar identifying symbol of the American West.
